Product Features

  • Irregular Shape for a Modern Design StatementFeaturing a thoughtfully designed irregular silhouette, this full length mirror adds visual interest and a contemporary touch to any space. The non-standard shape softens rigid interiors while complementing modern, minimalist, and design-forward environments.
  • 1. Full Lighting Control with Simple Touch Operation：Easily customize your lighting using the integrated touch button. Short press to switch between three color temperatures—6000K white, 4000K neutral, and 3000K warm light—while long press allows smooth, stepless dimming from 0% to 100%, giving you the ideal brightness for grooming, styling, or ambiance.
  • Premium 5mm Copper-Free Silver Mirror：Crafted from high-quality 5mm copper-free silver glass, this mirror delivers a clear, distortion-free reflection while offering improved resistance to oxidation and corrosion, making it suitable for long-term use in both residential and commercial environments.
  • Shatter-Resistant & Moisture-Proof Construction：The back of the mirror is reinforced with a safety explosion-proof film that helps prevent glass scattering if impacted. Combined with moisture-resistant and anti-oxidation properties, it ensures enhanced durability and safer everyday use.
  • Wall-Mounted Design with Secure Installation：Designed for wall mounting, the mirror includes hanging plates for accurate positioning and stable support. A complete mounting kit is provided, along with 3M adhesive strips for secondary reinforcement, helping reduce movement and improve overall installation security.

body_html:
Details

*Features*:

*Multifunctional Aquarium Gravel Cleaner*:Our multifunctional aquarium gravel cleaner kit includes rich accessories to achieve comprehensive fish cleaning jobs. The gravel head with dense-holes design and filter net can ensure quick sand,debris and fish feces filtration while preventing accidently sucking away your beautiful fishes. Silicone cleaning head works great on removing those stubborn stains attached to the fish tank glasses,and 27.55in water hose allows you to effectively change the dirty water.
*Efficient & Powerful Cleaning*:Equipped with powerful and low noise motor,our upgraded fish tank vacuum cleaner delivers strong suction and up to 137GPH water flow,high-efficiency working performance filters fish poop and food residue,providing a clean and healthy living environment for your pet fishes. Compared to those manual cleaner,this electric aquarium vacuum cleaner is much more convenient and time-saving.
*Adjustable Length*:Come with 2 replaceable water tubes with different length,you can adjust this extendable fish tank vacuum cleaner from 22.83in to 37.2in to fit for various sizes of fish tanks or diverse water levels. Please notice that the short tube and long tube cannot be used simultaneously.
*Dual Power Supplies*:We offer 2 kinds of power supply methods for you to choose,you can either use 2Pcs LR20 batteries(not included) to enjoy the freedom of cordless operation without dragging cord and distance restriction,or you are able to use the included adapter with 59.05in power cord,saving your effort of changing batteries.
*Easy Installation & Replacement*:No tools or screws required,you can simply assemble or disassemble this electric aquarium vacuum gravel cleaner according to our detailed user manual,making maintenance a breeze.
